integrity: The original map, volume invariance and ergodicity are credited to the originating paper; the explicit correlation transform, first negative lag, and map-specific martingale-coboundary identity are the new assertions. Independent external verification has not been performed.
limitations: The correlation formula applies to affine observables of the stated map under normalized Lebesgue volume; the CLT holds for each fixed dimension, with no asserted rate of Gaussian approximation or full transfer-spectrum characterization. An unindexed equivalent calculation is possible.
title: Exact delayed anticorrelation and dimension-free diffusivity for twisted baker maps
